title: 2013 AMC 10A Problem 2
statement: Alice is making a batch of cookies and needs \(2\frac{1}{2}\) cups of sugar. Unfortunately, her measuring cup holds only \(\frac{1}{4}\) cup of sugar. How many times must she fill that cup to get the correct amount of sugar?

solutions.text:
Alice needs \(2\frac12=\frac52\) cups of sugar.

Each full measuring cup gives \(\frac14\) cup, so the number of fillings is \(\frac52\div\frac14=\frac52\cdot4=10\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Convert the mixed number of cups to an improper fraction
Divide the needed sugar by the cup size
